slots.jd.freight-company.about:
Position summary
Whitcombe Logistics Group is seeking an Administrative Assistant to support its on-site office in Memphis, TN. The role provides administrative support to the operations team of a freight company and keeps records, purchasing and correspondence accurate and on schedule.
Minimum: experience in office administration and working knowledge of standard office software.
Preferred: experience in a freight or logistics setting.
slots.jd.freight-company.duties:
Responsibilities
- Process employee expense reports, checking receipts against company policy before submission for approval.
- Order office and operations supplies, track deliveries and keep stock at agreed levels.
- Take accurate notes at team and management meetings and circulate them to attendees promptly.
- Maintain organized physical and digital files for purchasing and administrative records.
- Serve as a point of contact for staff questions on administrative procedures.
slots.jd.freight-company.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 5 or more years of experience in an administrative support role.
- Demonstrated skill in vendor coordination, purchase ordering and invoice processing.
- Experience with visitor reception and handling incoming calls in a professional manner.
- Ability to prepare clear meeting minutes and distribute them on time.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook for email and calendar management.
- Office Administration Certificate required.
slots.r1.b1: Maintain records filing for client and office documents, reorganizing the shared archive and cutting document retrieval time by 25 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Cover office phones and greet visitors at reception, handling purchase ordering for front desk supplies between calls.
slots.r1.b3: Order office supplies and manage invoice processing for each delivery, reducing late supplier payments by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Process staff expense reports and handle vendor coordination to confirm charges before reimbursement.
slots.r1.i1: Serve as the first point of contact at Elmstead Partners, covering office phones and receiving visitors as Administrative Assistant.
slots.r1.i2: Keep office files and records at Elmstead Partners organized, current and easy for staff to retrieve.
slots.r2.b1: Scheduled meetings and appointments for managers, preparing calendars and agendas in Microsoft Word and reducing scheduling conflicts by 10 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Recorded notes at staff meetings and handled visitor reception for attendees, distributing written summaries afterward.
slots.r2.b3: Arranged staff travel and events, tracking bookings and costs in Microsoft Excel and lowering travel spending by 35 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Maintained paper and digital records, filing itineraries and receipts from travel booking for later reference.
slots.r2.i1: Kept office files and records organized at Neighborhood Table Services as Office Assistant, supporting daily operations.
slots.r2.i2: Processed expense reports for staff at Neighborhood Table Services, checking receipts and preparing reimbursements on schedule.
slots.summary.1: Administrative support specialist with about 5 years of experience owning recurring office processes from request to completion. Handles purchase ordering, travel booking and document preparation in Microsoft Word.
slots.summary.2: Specialist-level administrative support professional with 5 years of experience taking routine requests through to completion. Skilled in purchase ordering, travel booking, Microsoft Word, invoice processing and vendor coordination.
